fills.name: Muster Highland Archers
fills.quote: MUSTER HIGHLAND ARCHERS / Call upon the Highlands / 600 / 05s / Call upon loyal Highland chiefs to recruit 9 Highland Archers to the Mustering Hall. Can ... [selected: MUSTERING HALL Technology & Military Building]
fills.note: The tooltip is on the Mustering Hall command card with the Mustering Hall selected. The button only unlocks at Mustering Hall Influence Tier 1 (3 structures): 'Unlocks Mustering of Highland Archers.'

fills.name: Muster Cateran
fills.quote: MUSTER CATERAN / Call upon the Highlands / 600 / 05s / Call upon loyal Highland chiefs to recruit 8 Caterans to the Mustering Hall. Can only be used once. [selected: MUSTERING HALL Technology & Military Building]

fills.name: Muster Gallowglass
fills.quote: MUSTER GALLOWGLASS / Call upon the Highlands / 1080 / 05s / Call upon loyal Highland chiefs to recruit 7 Gallowglass to the Mustering Hall. Can only be used once. [selected: MUSTERING HALL Technology & Military Building]
fills.note: The cost shown is 1080 because the hall is at Influence Tier 2 (-20%). At c_oaynL66jY s_01235 (20:35, Tier 3) it shows 810. The base cost is 1350.

fills.name: Muster Tacksmen
fills.quote: MUSTER TACKSMEN / Royal Summon / 1350 / 05s / Call upon loyal Highland chiefs to recruit 7 Tacksmen to the Mustering Hall. Can only be used once. Requirements: Imperial Age (IV) [selected: MUSTERING HALL Technology & Military Building]
fills.note: The same button appears on the Mustering Hall at wzT5WTqIIU4 s_00676 (11:16), showing a reduced cost of 810. The tooltip class line is 'Royal Summon', not 'Call upon the Highlands'.

fills.name: Muster Tacksmen
fills.variant: alternate muster site (Three Loch Lookout landmark command card)
fills.quote: MUSTER TACKSMEN / Royal Summon / 1350 / 05s / Call upon loyal Highland chiefs to recruit 7 Tacksmen to the Mustering Hall. Can only be used once. [selected: THREE LOCH LOOKOUT Age IV - Military Landmark, Highlands]
fills.note: The Three Loch Lookout can also muster. Its own tooltip says it 'adds 3 muster charges for the Mustering Hall or Three Loch Lookout'. Its charge counter reads 3.

fills.name: Upgrade to Veteran Cateran
fills.quote: UPGRADE TO VETERAN / Unit Technology 1/2 / 50 / 125 / 30s / Upgrade Cateran to Veteran Cateran. / Requirements: Castle Age (III) [selected: BARRACKS Military Building]
fills.note: Extracted from the mp4 at 489.7 s because the tooltip shows for less than 1 s, between the 2 s samples s_00488 and s_00490. It is the D button in the second row of the Barracks command card. The tooltip also confirms the cost (50 food, 125 gold) and time (30s).

fills.name: Upgrade to Elite Gallowglass
fills.quote: UPGRADE TO ELITE / Unit Technology 1/1 / 300 / 700 / 1m 0s / Upgrade Gallowglass to Elite Gallowglass. / Requirements: Imperial Age (IV) [selected: BARRACKS Military Building]
fills.note: It is the F button in the second row of the Barracks command card.

fills.name: Upgrade to Elite Cateran
fills.quote: ALL (10) [Barracks selection] - second-row unit-upgrade buttons A S D F all show research progress bars; four upgrade icons queued; 29:19 (s_01759): 'Upgrade to Elite completed' x4
fills.note: No frame shows the Elite Cateran tooltip itself. On the Barracks, the Cateran upgrade chain is the D button ('Unit Technology 1/2' for Veteran at xjYytU_zXTA 08:09). The class line 'Unit Technology 2/2' implies the Elite step is the next research on that same button. In this Imperial Age frame, 10 Barracks are researching all four unit upgrades (A, S, D, F), and four 'Upgrade to Elite completed' notices appear 11 s later.

fills.name: Fairy's Protection
fills.quote: FAIRY'S PROTECTION / Tower House Technology / Create a Stealth Forest at this Tower H[ouse]. The first 3 Stealth Forests from Tower [Houses] come with no cost. [selected: TOWER HOUSE Defensive Building]
fills.note: Re-extracted at 2190 s. The OCR index also has this tooltip on a selected Tower House at qlogYcWhKEU 25:38 (pruned).

fills.name: Siege Tower
fills.value: None - field-built by melee and ranged infantry after Siege Engineering (Blacksmith)
fills.quote: SIEGE ENGINEERING / Siege Unit Unlock / 50 / 125 / 30s / Melee and ranged infantry can construct Siege Towers and Battering Rams in the field. [selected: BLACKSMITH Technology Building]
fills.note: The Scots Siege Workshop command card has no Siege Tower button. At c_oaynL66jY s_01873 (31:13, Imperial) the card shows Q/W/E/R plus A/S siege icons: mangonel, trebuchet, a ram-like wagon, and two cannons, but no tower. This matches the base game, where siege towers come only from infantry.

fills.name: Lowland Landmark Technology Discount
fills.value: Lowland technology costs are reduced by 50%.
fills.quote: STONE OF DESTINY / Lowland Landmark / Lowland technology costs are reduced by 50%.
fills.note: This is the first Lowland landmark. The tooltip is on the landmark slot of the selected Mustering Hall. The second-landmark variant ('Multiple Landmarks from the Lowlands constructed. Lowland technology costs are further reduced by 50%.', Snowdoun Gate, c_oaynL66jY 20:28 / qlogYcWhKEU 27:52) is already in the checklist as a variant. The same base text appears at wzT5WTqIIU4 4:34.

fills.name: Regional tech discount
fills.value: As Landmarks are constructed from a region, the associated technologies halve in cost for its support.
fills.quote: Lowlands and Highlands: Choose between a Highland or a Lowland Landmark each time when aging up. The Mustering Hall holds unique technologies from these lands. As Landmarks are constructed from a region, the associated technologies halve in cost for its support.
fills.note: This is the civ Overview bonus text; the regional-discount sentence is the last one. The same text appears at qlogYcWhKEU 0:10. In game, each landmark slot on the Mustering Hall shows a per-region line: Lowland 'Lowland technology costs are reduced by 50%.' and Highland 'further reduced by 50%' (see the variant).

fills.name: Regional tech discount
fills.value: Multiple Landmarks from the Highlands constructed. Highland technology costs are further reduced by 50%.
fills.variant: second Highland landmark (Three Loch Lookout) slot tooltip on Mustering Hall
fills.quote: THREE LOCH LOOKOUT / Highland Landmark / Multiple Landmarks from the Highlands constructed. Highland technology costs are further reduced by 50%.
fills.note: The Highland counterpart of the Lowland discount. No frame showing the first-Highland-landmark wording was found.

fills.name: Castle Ruins
fills.value: Upon destruction, Keeps adopt scorched earth tactics and sabotage the immediate area for a duration. If any enemies are within the area of sabotage their combat effectiveness is temporarily reduced. During this time Keeps become Keep Ruins and can be saved from total destruction if repaired. Keep Ruins can be fully restored for up to maximum of 600 Stone after which repairing Keep Ruins becomes free.
fills.quote: Castle Ruins / Upon destruction, Keeps adopt scorched earth tactics and sabotage the immediate area for a duration. If any enemies are within the area of sabotage their combat effectiveness is temporarily reduced. During this time Keeps become Keep Ruins and can be saved from total destruction if repaired. Keep Ru[i]ns can be fully restored for up to maximum of 600 Stone after which re[p]airing Keep Ruins becomes free.
fills.note: From the civ Overview, Bonuses panel. The mouse cursor partly covers 'Ruins' and 'repairing' in this frame. OCR of the neighbouring frames s_00862 to s_00914 reads both words in full. The overview gives no sabotage duration. The datamined Keep description gives 60 seconds, but that is not on screen here.
